findings.description: MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine.verifyThermalDissipation currently executes a one-way transfer: electrical powers are calculated once at nominal room temperature (25°C) and fed into thermal evaluation. No temperature values are fed back into circuit resistance or diode saturation parameters.
findings.remediation: Implement an iterative co-simulation loop with relaxation where component temperatures update electrical resistance R(T) = R_0[1 + alpha(T - T_ref)] and diode thermal voltage Vt = k_B*T/q, re-solving until convergence.

findings.description: MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine.verifyThermalDissipation uses a simplified 1D junction-to-ambient lumped model (Tj = Tamb + P * thetaJa) instead of utilizing the 2D finite-volume SpatialThermalSolver developed in 001B.
findings.remediation: Directly couple NodalCircuitSolver with SpatialThermalSolver, mapping circuit component dissipation to 2D board coordinates and extracting local board and junction temperatures.

findings.description: No formal convergence criteria (absolute temperature residual, relative parameter residual) or under-relaxation schemes currently exist for cross-domain electrothermal feedback, risking numerical oscillation or divergence under high thermal sensitivity.
findings.remediation: Incorporate adaptive or fixed under-relaxation theta in (0, 1] and strict convergence thresholds: delta_T < 1e-3 K, delta_R / R < 1e-4, energy balance check <= 0.1%.

findings.description: No verification gate audits whether total electrical power dissipated across the circuit matches total heat rate expelled through convection and heat sinks.
findings.remediation: Enforce explicit energy conservation checking in the electrothermal solver with relative tolerance <= 0.1%.

conclusion: The platform possesses production-grade nonlinear electrical (001A) and spatial multilayer thermal (001B) solvers. The critical missing capability is the closed-loop, relaxed iterative co-simulation bridge that binds them into a unified thermodynamic-electrical truth.
